name: Logic
description:
In the context of propositional and predicate logic the following basic 
notions are covered: 
- Syntax and semantics 
- Proof system and proof search 
- Soundness and completeness 
- Decidability 
- Expressiveness 
Possible further topics (non exhaustive): 
- Proof systems 
- Automated theorem proving 
- Verification 
- Decision procedures 
- Prolog 
- Data base theory 
- Higher-order logic 
- Set theory 
- Constructive logic 
- Fuzzy logic.
